title: creative.generated
description: PAYLOAD of the `creative.generated` envelope. Topic: creative.creative.generated. Emitted by creative-studio (§15.2) when one creative asset finishes the pipeline (brief -> layout -> background -> typography -> brand -> locale) and is registered in the DAM with Creative DNA tags + embedding. The gen-background step REUSES the live AI Asset Service (:8310 OpenRouter gemini-2.5-flash-image, Tenant Zero). One event per asset. creative-qa (§15.4) then evaluates it (creative.qa.evaluated).

cib_ref.description: The CIB whose diversity cell this asset fills (§15.2 brief = CIB cell).

url.description: Object-store URL of the rendered asset (DO Spaces, reused live store §4.2).

dna.description: Creative DNA tags — the attribute-level learning substrate (§15.5, moat (2)). Learning happens at THIS level (§14.1 gene-level posteriors).

angle.description: Angle id/name from the diversity matrix (§9.3).

hook_type.description: e.g. question, discount, social_proof, urgency, problem_agitate.

language.description: BCP-47 locale of the copy (vernacular first-class §11/I13).

headline.description: Rendered headline text (deterministic typography layer §15.2; gen models garble text so this is composited, not generated-in-image).

gen_source.description: Provenance of the background (vendor photo > gen for authenticity §15.2).

rights.description: Usage rights (§15.5) — required before an asset is launchable.

embedding_ref.description: Pointer to the asset embedding (pgvector) used for Entity-ID cluster-risk scoring (§15.4) and reuse search.

brand_kit_version.description: Brand-kit version this render referenced (§15.1 every render cites a version).
